mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user_footprint` (user_id, scenic_id, city, city_code, longitude, latitude, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{scenicId}, #{city}, #{cityCode}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city_code) FROM `user_footprint` WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT city, city_code AS cityCode, COUNT(*) AS count, MAX(created_at) AS lastVisit FROM `user_footprint` WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY city, city_code ORDER BY lastVisit DESC
